description: This file defines a generic CRUD controller factory for Mongoose models, incorporating tenant scope enforcement, request handling for list, getById, create, update, and remove operations, along with validation, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: validateSort(sort, allowed = ['timestamp', 'created_at', '_id'])
methods.description: Validates a sort string against allowed fields, ensuring safe sorting to prevent heavy in-memory operations.

methods.name: clampLimit(limit, max = 500)
methods.description: Adjusts a limit parameter to enforce a maximum value for safety.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a value from in-memory micro cache if it is not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Sets a value in in-memory micro cache with a TTL (time to live).

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a cache key based on request parameters and query options for caching list responses.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant(req)
methods.description: Sanitizes incoming payloads to remove client-provided tenant identifiers and injects the tenant ID from request context.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant(filter, tenantId)
methods.description: Merges a given filter with enforced tenant filter, removing client-supplied tenant hints.

methods.name: buildCrudController(Model, listDefaultSort = '-timestamp')
methods.description: Builds a comprehensive CRUD controller for a Mongoose model, incorporating tenant enforcement, flexible listing, error handling, and caching.
